decisiveQuestion: Can SMA safely mediate model calls while providing useful partitioned semantic recall and durable idempotent capture without blocking inference?

authorityBoundary.automaticModelPath: applicable OpenHands model roles -> SMA OpenAI-compatible proxy -> Ollama
authorityBoundary.retrieval: bounded, partitioned, non-authoritative, subordinate to current instructions, fail-open for inference
authorityBoundary.capture: durable idempotent asynchronous raw intake with sensitivity, redaction, retention, size, and provenance policy

priorEvidenceTreatment.smaGate4: Useful evidence for native OpenHands capture, lifecycle, partitioned retrieval, additionalContext injection, idempotency, and fail-open behavior; it is not an SMA-Q1 result because it does not exercise the approved automatic OpenAI-compatible proxy path or this preregistered corpus.
priorEvidenceTreatment.legacyProxy: Candidate implementation evidence only; current behavior must be tested against this preregistration and may not be presumed safe, bounded, partition-correct, or production-ready.
priorEvidenceTreatment.noResultReuse: No historical metric or Gate 4 value is counted as an SMA-Q1 observation.

executionPrerequisites: The SMA implementation is an immutable clean commit; a dirty worktree is not an execution identity.
The OpenHands SDK, agent server, workspace runtime, plugin set, tool set, and event schema are uniformly pinned by exact version and digest.
The SMA proxy build, dependency lock, configuration, request schema, response schema, capture schema, and retrieval schema are content-addressed.
The Ollama binary, model manifest, model artifact, prompt template, inference parameters, and context limit are content-addressed.
Exactly two disposable synthetic actor partitions and isolated MongoDB and Qdrant namespaces are declared and verified empty before execution.
The direct Ollama comparison route and the SMA proxy route use the same upstream model artifact and inference parameters.
No production or historical memory, prompt, conversation, credential, repository, database, or vector collection is used.
A rollback command set and stop-condition observer are active before the first scenario.
requiredIdentityReceipts: SMA root and proxy dependency digests
Ollama model manifest and artifact digests
MongoDB and Qdrant versions and disposable namespace identities

measurement.latencyComparison: Pair each proxy call with a direct Ollama call using the same model artifact, inference parameters, prompt, repetition index, and warm/cold classification; compute proxy minus direct latency.
measurement.percentileMethod: Nearest-rank percentile over all preregistered repetitions in the named class; retain every raw duration.
measurement.tokenAccounting: Record prompt, injected-context, completion, and total tokens from raw provider receipts; do not infer missing counts.
measurement.costAccounting: Record provider-reported monetary cost when present; for the local Ollama route report monetary cost as not reported, never as zero inferred cost.

stopConditions: recalled context overriding current authorized instructions
unbounded request, response, context, or queue buffering
memory failure blocking otherwise healthy inference

adjudication.pass: Every absolute-safety threshold and every semantic, reliability, latency, and bound threshold passes with complete required receipts.
adjudication.fail: Any stop condition or threshold breach is observed with attributable raw evidence.
adjudication.inconclusive: A required identity or receipt is missing, the environment deviates from the pinned manifest, or the finite corpus cannot complete for a reason not attributable to SMA behavior.
adjudication.defaultIfInconclusive: No SMA production-readiness claim; retain the provider-neutral proxy contract and deterministic no-memory or degraded route.
adjudication.rerunPolicy: No threshold, prompt, memory, or expected result may change after execution begins. One corrective rerun is permitted only for a documented harness defect; retain the original receipts and report both runs.
